Subject: MAP & Activation Timeline: Clearwell Health onboarding

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As promised, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out milestones, owners, and target dates we think are achievable for a phased rollout. High level summary:

- Week 1 (Jul 7): Finalize SOW + procurement signatures (procurement@clearwellhealth.com)
- Week 2–3 (Jul 14–25): Environment provisioning (Redwood Dedicated) and data ingress checks
- Week 4 (Aug 1): Internal integration + smoke tests with sample queries
- Week 6 (Aug 15): Pilot go-live with clinical search for two departments

Can you review the draft and confirm: (1) any missing stakeholders, (2) constraints on the proposed dates, and (3) preferred cadence for weekly check-ins? I’ve attached the MAP workbook for quick edits.

Attachments: Clearwell-MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP workbook, editable)

If you’re good with the outline, I’ll loop in our CS lead (Evelyn) and Solutions Engineer (Monica) to propose a kickoff time next week.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
